mappings.coverage: complete qualified prepared original own-body memory projection
mappings.qualification: Complete prepared own-body stores and meaningful allocator return for 684ee0 / 6550b0 / 655940 / 655ba0 / 655da0. Original orientation and allocator children execute unchanged in native tests. Physical record capacity comparison is signed; only 0/FFFFFFFF/null/disabled records are explicit guards. Other signed IDs and selectors require readable backing, tested with adjusted base. Per-store live emitter base reloads, original record cached across timing callback, fresh per-sound count/table reads, cached clock, unsigned output sentinel, and final linked-list head reread preserved. Timer callback may retarget base, record table, record fields, clocks, or output ID; constructor cached ID and allocation flag survive. Alias cases include head next-store aliasing head and sound-count aliasing first sound store.
